title: Concept: Python requirement installed from a git remote
description: requirements.txt declares a requirement installed straight from a git remote, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The installed code is outside index publication controls, so no index signature, hash or advisory range covers it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: The installed code is outside index publication controls, so no index signature, hash or advisory range covers it.
